articles.summary: At A3F in Zurich, Bloom showed how creating software can become more personal, immediate, and accessible — including a demo with Steve Wozniak.
articles.title: Steve Wozniak Meets the Future of Personal Software

articles.summary: Opus 4.8 is now available in Bloom. It’s a bit smarter across the board, but more importantly, it’s more efficient. Meaning it will use fewer credits to get the same work done compared to Opus 4.7.
articles.title: Opus 4.8 in Bloom

articles.summary: Meet Daud, the 19-year-old Bloomathon winner who built a voice-first social app with 30-second audio posts, synced transcripts, and a feed.
articles.title: Bloomathon Winner – Voice-First Social App
